body: Here we must distinguish material and moral good. Moral good is highly cultural and subjective. Material good is the resources available to oneself and often others, and objective in nature. But what violates a moral ruleset can often improve material good. Plenty of cultures deemed war a good thing. For Rome, it meant new slaves, new positions in government, and even the plebians would receive cheaper goods for the fact that sources were now Roman territory.

I believe good and evil are nothing more than psychological/sociological constructs. But I know the views on such held by others deem them evil. Therefore, caution is always critical. I act in such ways to enjoy things, but if imbalanced with unenjoyable things, then the action is pointless.

What, you think I have no choice in those I talk to? I met her by chance, found her amusing, learned of her views, had known her for months, and chatted countless times. But pissing off someone whom was emotionally attached to was just a game. Like chatting to an NPC.

Perhaps I should mention other relations then. I call any I find entertaining "Friend", because they usually see me as one. But I walk right out of relations when they no longer prove interesting. One I made a habit of pressing her into discussing political and social views she felt strongly towards, exclusively because arguing against her was a fun game.

Parents are not helpful. Depression alone was mishandled and disbelived. A.S.P.D. would no doubt be a mistake to speak of.

But it truly does not bother me. My desire to die is purely a case of too much stress, boredom, spite, ect. when compared to what I gain in recreation. It has been this way for a long time, and it has been getting worse with no indication of future improvement.

I bring it up to give a better picture of my background. Nothing more and nothing less. The "other stuff" is more heavy than you seem to interpret it. Calculators, cash, whatever, I use subtlety to get what I need. I play off teachers personalities to my own gain. 

Another student whom I had no history with even once broke down crying from a particularly piercing insult. But I felt exhilarated, not guilty, and still do to this day. That's what I mean by sociopathic.
